lighting.type: Abundant natural light diffused by sheer curtains, supplemented by warm recessed ceiling lights, a modern linear pendant light, and an arc floor lamp.

prompts.positive: A luxurious and modern open-plan living and dining space, featuring an elegant L-shaped light beige fabric sofa, a sleek marble-top dining table with dark wood legs and upholstered chairs. White shaker-style kitchen cabinets with dark handles, a large white refrigerator, and a stylish linear pendant light. Abundant natural light filtered through sheer white curtains, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. Light wood-look flooring, painted white walls, and a fluted glass partition. Clean lines, subtle curves, sophisticated neutral color palette of off-white, light grey, and dark brown accents. Minimalist decor with a touch of warmth.
prompts.negative: Cluttered space, outdated furniture, overly vibrant or saturated colors, poor lighting, traditional heavy curtains, dark and gloomy atmosphere, cheap materials, visible wires.
